description: This PHP file contains a unit test class 'LanguageServiceTest' that tests the 'LanguageService' class methods related to managing language entities, including retrieving lists, deleting, and fetching by ID or name. It sets up test data, mocks dependencies, and verifies expected behaviors for the service layer.

classes.name: LanguageServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the 'LanguageService' functionalities including retrieval, deletion, and lookup of language entities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of 'LanguageService', loading fixture data from a YAML file, and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetLanguageList
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a list of Language entities via the 'getLanguageList' method, ensuring correct data is returned.

methods.name: testDeleteLanguages
methods.description: Verifies that the 'deleteLanguages' method correctly deletes specified language IDs and returns the expected count.

methods.name: testGetLanguageById
methods.description: Tests fetching a single Language entity by its ID using 'getLanguageById' method.

methods.name: testGetLanguageByName
methods.description: Tests fetching a Language entity by its name using 'getLanguageByName' method.
